correctness.rationale: A nondegenerate Hermitian polarity proves the exact number and multiplicity of external crossings for all q; Frobenius-fixed lines and crossings are counted directly from F_q-rational isotropic points, and normalization gluing proves the all-m extension counts and zeta product. Rational line-conic duality versus characteristic-two concurrency proves the full branch spectra. The q=2,3 finite-field checks independently match these consequences.

This is a substantial dependence, credited explicitly.

value.rationale: The complete union of all tangent lines to the Hermitian unital is a canonical, natural plane-curve divisor. Its all-extension zeta function and integral Frobenius rational-branch census give an infinite q-uniform arithmetic description not specified by geometric singularity counts. The contrast between pairwise rational tangents in odd characteristic and total concurrence in even characteristic is a structural boundary, not a selected numerical slice.
